# ORCA fixtures — provenance

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Engine | ORCA 6.1.1 (RELEASE), linux x86-64 shared OpenMPI |
| Host | ThinkEndeavour (Xavier's laptop), 2 cores |
| Input | generated by `buildOrcaInput()` from `src/shared/engines/orca.js` |
| Date | 2026-11-10 |

Every fixture below marked **real** is a **verbatim excerpt** of one run. The
retained lines are byte-identical to what ORCA wrote; the sections between them
were removed so the fixture stays small. No number was edited.

## `methanol-nmr.out` (issue 284)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Route | `! B3LYP def2-SVP NMR`, `%pal nprocs 2 end` |
| Block | `%EPRNMR` with `NUCLEI = ALL H/C/O { SHIFT, SSALL }` |
| Molecule | methanol, CH3OH, 6 atoms, charge 0, multiplicity 1 |
| Outcome | SCF converged in 8 cycles, −115.56211637243774 Eh; terminated normally in 15.8 s |
| Shieldings (ppm) | C 141.174, O 342.467; H 28.336, 28.175, 28.175, 32.237 |
| Couplings (Hz) | J(C,H) 179.858, J(O,H) −91.723, J(C,O) 15.511 |
| Full log | 8,514 lines / 471 KB; this excerpt keeps the banner, input echo, SCF result, shielding summary, coupling summary and termination line |

ORCA numbers nuclei from **0** in input order. The shielding reader shifts that
to the app's 1-based atom order; the coupling matrix keeps ORCA's 0-based order,
as its `indexing` field states.

## `water-tddft.out`, `ethene-tddft.out` (issue 285)

Generated by `buildOrcaInput()` (`jobType: 'TD-DFT'`, `tdStates: 5`,
B3LYP/def2-SVP, `%pal nprocs 2`).

| Fixture | Molecule | Outcome | First root |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water-tddft.out` | H2O, 3 atoms | SCF converged in 8 cycles, E(SCF) = -76.32111959665978 Eh, 11 s | 7.584350 eV, 163.5 nm, f = 0.018099348 |
| `ethene-tddft.out` | C2H4, 6 atoms | SCF converged, E(SCF) = -78.47317204034394 Eh, 13 s | 8.136085 eV, 152.4 nm, f = 0.375187279 (pi->pi*) |

Both logs close with `CIS/TD-DFT TOTAL ENERGY` (`E(tot) = E(SCF) + DE(CIS)`,
Root 1) and print that total as `FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY`. The parser reports
the SCF energy as the final energy and keeps the decomposition in
`excitedStates.totalEnergy`.

Cross-check: the same B3LYP/def2-SVP water calculation in PySCF 2.15
(`tdscf.TDDFT`) gives 7.598 eV for the first root, 0.014 eV away; ethene gives
8.140 eV and f = 0.375 in PySCF against 8.136 eV and 0.3752 here.

**ORCA 6 does not accept a `TDDFT` (or `TD-DFT`) keyword on the simple input
line** — a 6.1.1 run stops with `UNRECOGNIZED OR DUPLICATED KEYWORD(S) IN SIMPLE
INPUT LINE`. The `%tddft` block alone switches the job on.

## `water-raman.out`, `chfclbr-vcd.out` (issue 288)

Both were generated by `buildOrcaInput()` and run on the same host on 2026-11-10.

| Fixture | Deck | Outcome | Table |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water-raman.out` | `! B3LYP def2-SVP NumFreq` + `%elprop Polar 1`, 33 s | E = -76.321089219655 Eh, terminated normally | 3 modes: 1596.13 cm⁻¹ (A = 6.367325, ρ = 0.524741), 3905.14 (74.743698, 0.166716), 4010.94 (34.699100, 0.749977) |
| `chfclbr-vcd.out` | `! B3LYP def2-SVP Opt Freq` + `%freq DOVCD true`, 167 s, CHFClBr (chiral) | E = -3172.098257770979 Eh, terminated normally | 9 modes, e.g. 218.8 cm⁻¹ → -0.21, 309.4 → +0.16, 423.4 → -0.60, 647.5 → +19.03 (1E-44 esu² cm²) |

ORCA 6 refuses `RAMAN`, `VCD` and `ROA` as simple-input keywords. Raman is
`NumFreq` + `%elprop Polar 1` (analytic Hessians are not available for Raman
intensities), VCD is `Freq` + `%freq DOVCD true` (ORCA refuses VCD with
`NumFreq`), and there is no ROA implementation to request.

The first water run in this session used a geometry with O-H 0.891 Å by mistake
and produced 898/4871/5074 cm⁻¹; it was discarded and re-run at 0.957 Å, giving
the values above. The repeat run reproduced 1596.13 / 3905.14 / 4010.94 to the
printed digits.

## `water-scan.out`, `nh3-optts.out`, `nh3-irc.out` (issue 286)

All three were generated by `buildOrcaInput()` and run on the same host on
2026-11-10 with `%pal nprocs 2`.

| Fixture | Deck | Outcome | Retained evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water-scan.out` | `! HF def2-SVP Opt` + `%geom Scan B 0 1 = 0.900000, 1.200000, 6 end end` | 6 s, terminated normally | `RELAXED SURFACE SCAN RESULTS`, 6 points from 0.900 to 1.200 Å: −75.95882048, −75.96109320, −75.95598798, −75.94605952, −75.93307006, −75.91823610 Eh |
| `nh3-optts.out` | `! HF def2-SVP OptTS` + `%geom Calc_Hess true end`, planar NH3 guess | 32 s, converged | `Lowest eigenvalues of the Hessian: -0.021825072`, `Hessian has   1 negative eigenvalues`, `Taking P-RFO step`, `THE OPTIMIZATION HAS CONVERGED` |
| `nh3-irc.out` | `! HF def2-SVP IRC` + `%irc MaxIter 20 end`, from the converged saddle | 5 min 58 s, converged | `IRC PATH SUMMARY`, 17 steps, `<= TS` at step 9 (E = −56.139541 Eh, dE = 0.000000), endpoints −56.148878 / −56.148879 Eh |

Facts this session established by running ORCA, not by reading the manual:

- `%geom Scan` **without** `! Opt` is ignored. The job banner reads
  "Single Point Calculation" and no scan table is printed; the same deck with
  `! Opt` runs a `Relaxed Surface Scan` (6 steps). `! Scan` is not a keyword.
- A scan line needs its own `end` inside `%geom`:
  `Scan B 0 1 = start, end, steps end`, then `end` for the block.
- ORCA numbers atoms from **0** in `%geom Scan`; `B 0 1` scanned the O–H bond.
- `! OptTS` without `%geom Calc_Hess true` ran a 50-cycle optimisation that did
  **not** converge; with the exact Hessian the same geometry converged in 32 s.
- The saddle's confirming `Freq` (same geometry, separate job) gives exactly one
  imaginary mode at **−907.22 cm⁻¹** and H–N–H modes at 1663.53 cm⁻¹ and above.
- An IRC summary is a single ordered list — backward end → TS → forward end —
  with no reaction coordinate column. `dE(kcal/mol)` is referenced to the TS.

## Synthetic fixtures

`water-sp.out`, `water-opt-freq.out`, `failure-scf.out` and `not-orca.out` are
trimmed blocks in the documented ORCA format used by the parser, gate and
termination tests. They were written from the manual's examples, not captured
from a run.
